== Summary ==
[[Kent Larsen]] asleep on a couch at the venue on the Saturday evening of the [[2022 European Championship]] in Bochum, Germany, from the "Team Wales Photo Log" thread.

* '''Event:''' [[2022 European Championship]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2022-09-13
* '''Identification:''' the post names "Kent" ("Saturday evening Kent missing some of his games again for some reason, and paying the price"). [[Kent Larsen]] is the only Kent who played the event.
